description: BenchBox-dev is on GitHub Free. Its three public repositories (BenchBox, benchbox-site, benchbox-sqlglot) share one cap of 20 concurrent jobs on standard hosted runners (https://docs.github.com/en/billing/reference/actions-runner-pricing), and peak demand reaches it: on 2026-10-28 and 2026-10-30, 20 jobs ran with up to about 200 queued. In the 2026-10-30 21:00-22:40 UTC window, core jobs waited a median of 22 minutes (p90 38) and site jobs about 18 minutes; oracle verdict review jobs have waited a median of 15 minutes since the single-job cutover. Core CI and Trunk use about 85-90% of runner time; the site uses 1-4% but queues behind core. Site deploys take a median of 64 minutes from core merge to live, about 49 of them before the site run starts. The site-repo split ADR (D13) deferred the site's runner choice until a month of deploy receipts existed; on the Free plan that choice is this org-wide capacity decision, so site-runner-pool-decision-20261017 is merged into this item.
